Read out of saint.gr's line for 1 Ιουλίου, «Άγιος Μαυρίκιος», with the rank word left off.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 21 februarie — «Sfântul Mucenic Mavrichie»

feast.note: saint.gr's page for this entry carries no life of its own: it prints the distich and then «Βλέπε στις 27 Δεκεμβρίου όπου και η βιογραφία του», sending the reader to its day page for 27 Δεκεμβρίου for the biography. That page has not been read in this wave, so 1 Ιουλίου — the day page actually read — is what is recorded, and whether the Greek calendar's proper day for him is 27 Δεκεμβρίου is a question left open (1 October 2026). The Romanian row keeps him on 21 februarie.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 1ης Ιουλίου — «Άγιος Μαυρίκιος»
